mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.25% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which depresses corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS occurs in more than 50% of cases where SPX 20-day returns are positive, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production level below 100 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals economic weakness and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad economic slowdown that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST occurs in more than 50% of cases where SPX 60-day returns are positive, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market downturn (HOUST < 1500 and RSAFS declining), consumer spending on durable goods weakens, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1500 and RSAFS is declining, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
